name: Strudel
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Combine apples, cinnamon, and sugar. Mix well.
Generously brush filo pastry sheets with butter.
Spread apple mixture over pastry sheet.
Alternate with two layers of filo pastry for every layer of apple mixture.
Bake for 30 minutes or until pastry is golden brown.

culture.text: Strudel is a type of layered baked good made with pastry, with a filling that is usually sweet, but savoury fillings are also common. It became popular in the 18th century throughout the Austrian Empire. Strudel is part of Austrian cuisine and German cuisine but is also common in other Central European cuisines. In Italy it is recognized as a prodotto agroalimentare tradizionale (PAT) of South Tyrol.
